description: This source file defines a Roslyn code fix provider for handling alias clashes in attributes within the Orleans.Analyzers namespace. It provides a fix that appends a suffix to an alias name detected to be clashing.

classes.name: AliasClashAttributeCodeFix
classes.description: A Roslyn CodeFixProvider that detects alias clash diagnostics and provides a fix by appending a suffix to the alias name.

methods.name: RegisterCodeFixesAsync
methods.description: Registers a code fix that, when applied, appends a suffix to the alias name in the detected attribute to resolve name clashes.

methods.name: GetFixAllProvider
methods.description: Returns a provider that enables batch fixing of diagnostics.
